snippet.title: Android Google Playstore Video for Store Page
snippet.description:
See it in action here (if it's still in action): 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=maui.spacepirate.game

---

Please support my game, Familia. It follows four protagonists through a journey to retake their homeland. 90s-kind Japanese role-playing games like Final Fantasy 1-6 highly influence the game's style. Play free now.

Act 1: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197520/Familia/
Act 2: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474730/Familia_Act_2/
Android: https://mauigamestudio.com/android
WebGL: https://mauigamestudio.itch.io/familia
Merch: https://mauigamestudio.com/shop/

Also, follow me on Twitch: 
https://www.twitch.tv/mauigamestudio
